steps: Confirm Guided is visible as a delivery policy distinct from workflow mode.
Confirm the primary actions and policy text fit without overlap.
Confirm prior passing evidence remains visible and is labelled stale.
Open the evidence details and return to the Studio.
Invoke Publish and confirm an explicit warning acknowledgement is required rather than a universal denial.
Run all real acceptance cases and observe a visible running state before the result.
Open the failed permission-boundary case and inspect its structured failure context.
Open repair preview, confirm the whole-workflow instruction and referenced context, then apply the repair once.
Confirm the resulting draft hash or revision changes and stale evidence is visible.
Click the model, HTTP request, and Loop blocks without a frontend crash.
Confirm each common block opens in a human-readable form by default.
Switch to Expert JSON and back, confirm unknown extension fields remain, and leave the saved workflow valid.
Confirm Governed and its explicit hard-gate policy are visible.
Invoke Publish and confirm the missing-evidence denial is actionable and matches the backend decision.
Select multiple blocks, pan the canvas, and open and close the inspector.
Confirm no incoherent overlap, uncaught exception, or console error appears.
